title: How U.S.-based Coupang is an economic bridge for America and Taiwan
summary: Discover how Fortune 150 U.S. retailer Coupang is expanding in Taiwan with major FDI, triple-digit growth, and Rocket Delivery to boost U.S.-Taiwan trade.
body_markdown:
Coupang, the U.S.-based technology and retail company, has been approved by the Taiwan government to make hundreds of millions of dollars in foreign direct investments (FDI) into the country to enhance customers’ experience there. The company has continuously brought new fulfillment centers (FCs) online and will leverage the newly approved FDI to accelerate expansion of its fulfillment and logistics network across Taiwan, improving services for customers and improving access to customers for merchants in Taiwan, Korea, Japan, Hong Kong and the U.S.


The trade and economic relationship between Taiwan and the U.S. has grown over the past 75 years to become critically important to both nations across many industries. Today, Taiwan is one of America’s largest trading partners and the world’s foremost manufacturing hub for advanced semiconductors, making it an important U.S. partner for global supply chain resilience, artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure development and mutual economic security.


Coupang offers next-day delivery service to a large majority of Taiwan’s geography.


Since launching its business in Taiwan in 2022,[Coupang](https://www.aboutcoupang.com/how-coupang-american-tech-company-went-global/) has made major investments in its Taiwan retail, fulfillment and logistics infrastructure, enabling next-day delivery service to a large majority of the country’s geography. With these investments, Coupang is[realizing its vision](https://www.aboutcoupang.com/coupang-taiwan-expansion/) for its Taiwan business: to help set the highest standards for speed, choice, cost and service quality for Taiwan customers and merchants, and to open a new bridge to the Taiwan economy for businesses in the U.S., Korea, Japan and Hong Kong.


“Taiwan is a critical U.S. partner, a dynamic economic powerhouse and is central to Coupang’s global strategy in every respect,” said Rob Porter, Coupang’s chief global affairs officer. “We’re very pleased that Coupang has helped boost trade and investment flows between the United States and Taiwan. Our rapid growth and investments in Taiwan reflect our conviction that the technology-enabled customer experience Coupang pioneered would be embraced by Taiwan customers, and that’s proven true.”


Coupang operates four smart fulfillment centers (FCs) in Taiwan.


Coupang drove more than $5 billion in sales and exports of American goods overseas in 2025, reaching millions of customers — including in Taiwan — by working with thousands of U.S. businesses. Coupang is also enabling Taiwan-based small and medium-size businesses to reach millions of customers across Taiwan with speed, convenience and efficiency.


## **Rocket-fast delivery leads to rocket-fast growth**


Coupang designed and built its own end-to-end fulfillment and logistics network.


As customers in Taiwan embrace Coupang’s Rocket Delivery service, expansive product choice and affordable prices, the company’s business is rapidly expanding in the market. Coupang’s business in Taiwan posted triple-digit growth year-over-year in 2025 as a critical part of Coupang’s Developing Offerings segment.


Coupang’s remarkable growth in Taiwan is enabling merchants across the country — and thousands of U.S. companies — to reach millions of Taiwanese customers through a seamless sales, fulfillment and logistics process. These investments not only create new opportunities for businesses, but also help deliver a more convenient and more reliable digital commerce experience for customers in Taiwan. In recognition for these achievements, Taiwan’s Ministry of Digital Affairs has awarded Coupang its Friendly E-Commerce Award three years in a row.


## **Building the Coupang experience in Taiwan**


Coupang is revolutionizing retail in Taiwan by relentlessly “wowing” customers, connecting businesses of all sizes to new customers and markets, and investing in AI, technology and process innovation. One of the ways Coupang has set new standards for customers’ online retail experience in Taiwan is by designing and building a fully company-owned end-to-end fulfillment and logistics network.


Customers in Taiwan can buy products from domestic sellers, as well as from the United States, South Korea, Japan and Hong Kong.


Customers in Taiwan can place an order on Coupang’s website by as late as midnight and receive locally stocked items as early as the next day through Rocket Delivery. With Dawn Delivery, which the company is now piloting in Taiwan, items can arrive as early as 7 a.m.


Additionally, through Rocket Overseas, customers can buy products from the United States, South Korea, Japan and Hong Kong, with delivery typically within three to five days. The transaction volume of Korean small and medium-sized business owners participating in Coupang’s overseas expansion support program in the Taiwan market in 2025 increased by about 81% compared to the same period last year.


## **Investing in Taiwan and a growing cultural partnership**


Coupang is continuing to invest in the growth of its Taiwan business. The company now has four smart fulfillment centers operating in Taiwan, significantly expanding Coupang’s existing workforce in Taiwan across fulfillment, delivery and corporate roles.


Coupang is also engaging with its Taiwan partners and neighbors to build strong cultural connections. In July 2026, Coupang sponsored American-themed festivities, including a baseball game, at the American Institute in Taiwan’s (AIT)[U.S.-Taiwan Friendship Night](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/robert-porter1826_america250-taiwanamericafriendshipday-ustaiwan-share-7481101067875938304-nKKL/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAmByyEBBu_oCZVfyIoq3D3mYJvXssHo3fU) , marking the 250th anniversary of American independence. Porter joined Taiwan Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim and AIT Director Raymond Greene for the ceremonial first pitch.


Taiwan Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim and Coupang Chief Global Affairs Officer Robert Porter attended the U.S.-Taiwan Friendship Night Baseball Game together.


“In Taiwan, we see opportunities to introduce innovative capabilities that will improve the service we provide and help further develop Taiwan’s digital infrastructure for the future,” said Bill Owens, head of Coupang Logistics Services (CLS) in Taiwan. “Our priority is to accelerate our long-term investments in Taiwan to help set even higher standards for speed, choice, cost and service quality for our customers here. Our goal is to deploy the same high-standard, frictionless experiences that have delighted our customers globally, so we can exceed expectations and ‘WOW’ every household in Taiwan.”


## Frequently asked questions


How does Coupang support U.S. businesses and U.S.-Taiwan trade?


In 2025, Coupang drove more than $5 billion in sales and exports of American goods overseas by partnering with thousands of U.S. businesses to reach millions of international customers, including in Taiwan. Through its end-to-end fulfillment and logistics network, Coupang provides a seamless channel for U.S. companies to export and sell their products directly to Taiwanese consumers.


What is Coupang’s current operational footprint in Taiwan?


Coupang operates four smart fulfillment centers in Taiwan and manages a company-owned, end-to-end fulfillment and logistics network. The company has significantly expanded its local workforce across fulfillment, delivery and corporate roles, and has been awarded the Friendly E-Commerce Award by Taiwan’s Ministry of Digital Affairs three years in a row.


How fast is Coupang’s business growing in Taiwan?


Coupang’s business in Taiwan posted triple-digit year-over-year growth in 2025 as a key part of the company’s Developing Offerings segment. Additionally, the transaction volume of Korean small and medium-sized businesses participating in Coupang’s overseas expansion program in Taiwan grew by approximately 81% in 2025 compared to the prior year.
